concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-masterpass-configuration]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree website configuration notice directing historical Masterpass users to SRC, with eligible-merchant limited-release, API-change and Client SDK-generation qualifications plus nonautomatic Sandbox/Production enablement; preserves the unresolved SRC end-of-support conflict and provides no client/server procedure, exact SDK/GitHub behavior, current enablement, safe migration path or payment-execution proof
